correctness.rationale: Survival probabilities by number of distinct backward ancestors yield q2(j)-4q1(j)/3=-1/3 only at j=4. Initial four occupied lineages coalesce at the first update at total rate four, giving the exact universal -1/12 constant; color symmetry and conditioning yield all exchangeable laws. Rational transient-generator elimination for all 38 four-node labeled connected graphs and all 3-node connected graphs verifies every listed graph-type value, six edge increments, and minimality, with independently run standard-library code. Unweighted finite computation is not used to infer universal weighted-network behavior.

originality.rationale: The proposed result is the weighted four-site identity, universal exchangeable-initial-law ranking, complete exact four-node simple-graph edge insertion table, and sharp four-node minimum. The individual constituent tools (coalescence, finite-state recurrence) and qualitative nonmonotone connectivity effects are known; the new synthesis is a precise invariant and sharp natural boundary. value.rationale: When the number of initial dissenters is uncertain but exchangeable, exact network ranking is a natural decision-relevant invariant; the unexpected four-site affine identity makes that ranking universal even on weighted directed networks. Complete simple-graph edge insertion classification identifies the first possible network size for a provable slowdown from extra contact and the only two local motifs attaining it. Both structural initial-law insensitivity and sharp minimal social-network size are meaningful beyond a numerical example; no empirical generalizations are claimed.
